events.title: The Bare Mat
events.opening_note: The Witnesses begin with proclamation and movement before choosing patrons or offices.

events.text: The party stated the purpose as preserving Reedwater through the next rains, restoring lawful provincial government, and converting emergency service into answerable duty rather than private title.

Emergency zones continue for seven days without expansion; new requisitions enter a provisional common ledger. Hearings are mixed, Reedwater witnesses are admitted before drafting, and a complete fallback will be maintained.

Every Reed must name its acting officer, effective hour, delivery route, correction route, and first petition forum. First-forty-days orders will be drafted with the offices.
Miya will authenticate and carry Reedwater testimony without claiming patronage or substantive agreement.

events.text: Miya Shun reserves four authenticated places for Reedwater testimony and begins the proclamation and first-forty-days registers before any office is awarded.

events.party_label: Qulan and Masami lead; Naritomo contests

events.text: The provisional Roads architecture uses Miya title, Unicorn execution through the first planting season, one dispatch law, no private toll privilege, a minimum open route, and district successors.
Requisition creates a valued debt against the benefiting office; emergency taking may precede valuation but not the debt. Waters must price and fund any route its design destroys.

events.text: Roads is provisionally assigned to Miya title and Unicorn execution without toll privilege; duplicate requisitions become office debts rather than invisible provincial loss.

events.closing_note: The party leaves with a provisional Roads architecture, a common requisition debt, and Reedwater witnesses admitted before drafting.

events.title: The Court Outside the Court
events.opening_note: Provincial testimony will test the relief systems before the Crane claim is converted into office.

events.party_label: All five before the Reedwater witnesses

events.text: Qulan acknowledged the unresolved Three Crossings horse debt; Naritomo entered checkpoint requisitions against Sword; Masami entered the pasture flooded by her emergency orchard cut.
The witnesses receive proclamations and corrections, burden-ledger access, petition without patron ownership, a review trigger, and return testimony. They do not endorse one design as a bloc.

events.text: Rei, Hojun, Saburo, and Kenta gain durable standing through implementation and autumn review; Masami’s orchard cut and Qulan’s missing horses enter the common burden record.
Harvest separates household relief, seed, garrison allotment, and emergency reserve. Seed cannot be opened by military declaration alone.
Masuyo accepts Miya title, Crane execution through the first harvest, outside audit, local standing, district successor wardens, and public credit that closes rather than renews the emergency claim.

events.text: The Crane prepare to return the white granary keys, retain one-harvest civilian execution, protect seed and household stores, and train district successors under outside audit.

events.closing_note: Reedwater gains durable standing; the Crane accept one-harvest civilian execution beneath Imperial title and outside audit.

events.title: White Keys and Red Standards
events.opening_note: The company must make military obedience and sacred consultation operative without making either decorative.

events.text: Sword receives Seppun title and removal, real Lion execution, a declining district roster, fixed supply, bounded emergency variance, staged replacement, and no automatic reversion after provincial failure.
The Lion renounce civilian Harvest and will lower the red standard before recommission. The Crane recognize the supply covenant and surrender independent armed command of relief escorts.
The Lion prepare a declining roster, return civilian granary control, lower their standard before recommission, and train the provincial patrol structure that ends their command.
Sacred consultation now requires notice, a recognized speaker, site examination, written response, decision, record, remedy, and review.
Site safety may proceed immediately; plan-preserving emergency work creates notice and debt; political sacrifice requires named Imperial authority or automatic hearing and restoration debt.

events.text: Phoenix specialists will coordinate consultation and restoration while local Reedwater speakers inherit the sacred standing; bypassed obligations create recorded spiritual debt.

events.closing_note: The Lion accept staged demobilization and visible submission; the Phoenix accept bounded consultation, emergency bypass, remedy, and local succession.

events.title: The Price of the Dike
events.opening_note: The court must choose a reconstruction burden and then place force beneath a legible Imperial chain.

events.party_label: Masami leads; Qulan prices the road

events.text: The party chose the northern channel as the long-term design and a Hundred-Day Brace as temporary protection. The duplicate cost, exposed district, substitute western route, and planting-season labor are entered explicitly.
Kaiu execution receives design, assigned labor and materials, and work-site command. Political sacrifice, route closure, termination certification, and autumn transfer remain outside the directorate.
The northern channel becomes the long-term design and the Hundred-Day Brace the temporary protection; Waters must fund the substitute western route and cannot choose political sacrifice alone.
Every force traces to an Imperial commission, named superior, term, removal, and failure successor. Current executors cannot resume authority automatically when a successor fails.
White keys, red standards, road tokens, requisition books, the engineer’s rule, Accounts custody, shrine registers, and the petition cord are prepared as operative submission instruments.

events.note: Established during The Price of the Dike from the court record accumulated through garden-of-white-gravel.

events.text: Every present armed or work-site force receives a traceable Imperial chain, term, removal authority, and failure successor; submission transfers command, custody, records, or legal status.

events.closing_note: The northern channel and Hundred-Day Brace are chosen; submission instruments and failure succession are prepared.

events.title: Masks, Ledgers, and the Judge Who Leaves
events.opening_note: The provincial bargains must become offices, records, inspection, recusal, and a lawful fallback.

events.text: The scribes exposed missing failure successors, valuation appeals, record custody, conflicting-order rules, and remedy powers. Every Reed now carries title, execution, audit, resources, emergency authority, succession, term, review, and remedy.

Autumn review may renew, narrow, replace, compensate, correct, remove, remedy, enforce debt, and activate failure succession. Gratitude, reimbursement, compensation, and office remain separate instruments.
The seven Reeds are separated into complete powers and instruments; the autumn review receives operative verbs rather than ceremonial observation.

Accounts keeps Imperial title and Miya custody. Scorpion inspectors receive access, comparison, preservation, protected reporting, and interim restraint; Dragon review and public disposition retain final authority.
Sadae disclosed and rejected Namika’s folded fallback. That draft can no longer operate as controlled leverage, though a lawful disclosed fallback remains possible.

events.reason: Sadae disclosed Namika’s folded fallback to the whole company; that secret draft can no longer function as bounded political leverage.

events.text: The Scorpion relinquish Accounts title and retain bounded inspection under divided custody, protected sources, independent review, and public disposition.

The common circuit now includes preservation, written reasons, conflict disclosure, recusal, substitute jurisdiction, deadlines, interim orders, appeal, and remedies, with a mixed provincial bench trained before autumn.

A new Narrow Imperial Peace fallback was drafted openly. Priority conflicts among site safety, life-preserving movement, food and petitions, and project schedules now have immediate and reviewable resolution.

events.reason: The party drafted a complete Narrow Imperial Peace openly, with its changed burdens and dependencies disclosed.

events.note: Established during Masks, Ledgers, and the Judge Who Leaves from the court record accumulated through stone-and-moss-court.

events.text: The common circuit gains deadlines and provincial succession; the secret fallback is replaced by a disclosed, complete Narrow Imperial Peace.

events.closing_note: Accounts is divided among custody, inspection, review, and disposition; one secret fallback is foreclosed and a disclosed fallback replaces it.

events.title: Moonlight and Ink
events.opening_note: Public obligations will be staged, then tested against the complete settlement stack and first-forty-days orders.

events.text: White keys and red standards, the road beside the new water, and the mask before the open ledger became witnessed public obligations. Dependencies and third-party burdens were named before applause.
The empty provincial cushion held Rei’s petition cord, Kenta’s patrol roster, Hojun’s keeper register, Saburo’s horse ledger, and district successor lists. The Emperor’s cup remained empty.
The principal relinquishments are publicly witnessed with exact scope and dependencies; no ceremony claims to invest authority before the Emperor acts.

events.party_label: All five Witnesses and rotating provincial chairs

events.text: The primary is Reedwater Succession under the Hundred-Day Brace; the fallback is a Narrow Imperial Peace. The settlement is divided among Mandate, recitals, schedules, covenants, proclamations, and registers.

Successor records, stores, initial pay, seals, and staged authority were moved into the first-forty-days bundle. Judgment succession now transfers case records and interim orders; review can remedy burdens already imposed.
The Chamber adopted the northern channel as the complete Waters design and moved directly to permanent construction without an intermediate emergency brace.

events.reason: The table had adopted the northern channel as the long-term design with a Hundred-Day Brace and temporary protections; the first summary omitted the intermediate works and their dependent promises.

events.text: The primary adopts the northern channel as the long-term design, authorizes a Hundred-Day Brace and temporary evacuation protections, funds substitute roads and surveys, and reserves phase-two burden review for autumn.

events.closing_note: The principal relinquishments become witnessed obligations; the primary and fallback leave the Chamber complete and correctable.

events.title: The Broad Sheet
events.opening_note: The Emperor will test authorship, obedience, capacity, burden, failure, and transition rather than count supporters.

events.party_label: All five Witnesses before the Emperor

events.text: The party named Three Crossings, western road households, the exposed district, and multiply burdened farming households rather than claiming that Reedwater pays uniformly.
The Emperor adopted the primary with a transition amendment barring executors from using withheld records, resources, instruction, or staged authority as grounds for renewal.
The primary Mandate is adopted with named amendments, and messengers leave with transfer, construction, patrol, ledger, inspection, shrine, and petition orders before court disperses.

events.closing_note: The primary is adopted with a transition amendment; first orders leave for Reedwater before the court disperses.
